## Pinterest – Workflow 1: Prepare Pins (runs weekly)

**What it does:** finds newly Posted blogs, reads the blog page, pulls all content images, plans pins (1 carousel of 3 hero images + single pins for the rest, 3/month), AI writes title/description/alt, auto-assigns Board from the Pinterest Boards tab by Category (AI picks the best fit when a category has more than one board), auto-sets Approval = Approved, and writes review rows to the Pinterest Pins tab -- no manual board pick or approval step.

**Setup:**
1. Credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2 + OpenAI API key on the relevant nodes.
2. Make sure the Pinterest Boards tab has a Category column filled in for the categories you want auto-assigned (a board's Category cell can list more than one, e.g. `Bathtub | Fireplace`).
3. Add Pinterest Status column to Blogs.
4. Check Set Config values.

**Note:** the image-extraction selector (Extract & Plan) may need tuning to your live blog HTML.

**Duplicate protection:** before fetching a blog's page, checks whether its URL already has a non-empty Pinterest Status elsewhere in Blogs/Manual Blogs (e.g. the same URL entered twice) -- if so, skips it and marks that row Pinterest Status = Duplicate instead of reprocessing it.

**Board fallback:** if no Pinterest board matches the blog's category, the row is written with Approval/Status = 'Needs Board' (not auto-Approved) so it never silently fails in WF2 -- a human assigns a board and flips it back to Review.
